## Test cases

### Verify admin approval with approval link email and also approve user through email

Tags: email, ci_cd

Source: `UR_tests/06__email_related_tests/admin_ approval_request_email_with_approval_link.robot`

Steps as written:

```
${user_name}=    RandomDataGenerator.Generate Random First Name
Login to Wordpress
Goto User Registration Settings'
Goto Emails setting
Goto Admin Approval Request Email with Approval Link email setting
Change Email Receipents for Admin
Click Element    ${btn_save_changes}
Add New Form    admin approval with approval link email
Goto form settings
Select 'User Approval And Login Option' as    admin_approval
Unselect Checkbox    ${enable_strong_password}
Click Button    ${update_form_btn}
Wait Until Page Contains    Success! Form successfully saved.
Click Element    ${preview_form_btn}
Switch Window    new
TRY
EmailDelivery_keywords.Register a new user    ${user_name}    ${password}    ${successful_msg}
EXCEPT    Element with locator '//div[@id="ur-submit-message-node"]/ul' not found.
EmailDelivery_keywords.Register a new user    ${user_name}    ${password}    ${successful_msg}
END
Goto Yopmail    themegrill123
Verify Email subject    Approval Needed: New Member Registration
Open Email with Subject >>    Approval Needed: New Member Registration
Click link of email body    Approve Now
Switch Window    new
```
